questions.text: Does the company maintain a current inventory of AI systems in use (built and third-party)?
questions.evidence: Spreadsheet of AI tools started in Q1 2026; 9 tools listed, last refreshed 2026-06.
euAiActRefs: EU AI Act art. 11 (technical documentation) [verify]
EU AI Act art. 12 (record-keeping) [verify]
questions.remediation: Stand up a lightweight AI-use registry with named owners and review cadence.

questions.text: Is each inventory entry assigned a business owner accountable for the system?
questions.evidence: Owners noted for 4 of 9 tools; rest unmapped.
euAiActRefs: EU AI Act art. 12 (record-keeping) [verify]
questions.remediation: Add an owner field to the registry; no orphan systems.

questions.text: Are data flows into and out of each AI system documented (inputs, outputs, retention)?
questions.evidence: No data-flow documentation exists for any tool.
euAiActRefs: EU AI Act art. 10 (data governance) [verify]
EU AI Act art. 12 (logging) [verify]
questions.remediation: Attach a one-page data-flow note per system.

questions.text: Is a documented AI risk assessment completed before a new AI system goes live?
questions.evidence: Informal security review for the pricing model only, by email thread 2026-03.
euAiActRefs: EU AI Act art. 9 (risk management system) [verify]
questions.remediation: Adopt a pre-deployment risk template with sign-off.

questions.text: Are risks re-assessed on a set schedule or upon material change, not just at launch?
questions.evidence: No re-assessment after the March launch.
euAiActRefs: EU AI Act art. 9 (risk management system) [verify]

questions.text: Does the company restrict or review high-risk uses (hiring, credit, biometrics, minors)?
questions.evidence: AI screening of driver applicants in pilot — no heightened review.
euAiActRefs: EU AI Act art. 5 (prohibited practices) [verify]
EU AI Act art. 6 (classification rules) [verify]
questions.remediation: Define a high-risk use list with mandatory review.

questions.text: Are AI vendor tools reviewed (security, data use, model changes) before purchase?
questions.evidence: Standard SaaS security questionnaire covers 3 of 6 AI vendors; skips model-change notices.
euAiActRefs: EU AI Act art. 9 (risk management system) [verify]
questions.remediation: Add AI vendors to procurement review with data-use questions.

questions.text: Do vendor contracts address AI-specific terms (training on your data, output IP, indemnity)?
questions.evidence: One DPA mentions no-training-on-our-data; others silent.
euAiActRefs: EU AI Act art. 10 (data governance) [verify]
questions.remediation: Adopt AI clause checklist for renewals and new deals.

questions.text: Is there a defined process for reporting AI incidents (errors, bias, harms, leaks)?
questions.evidence: No AI-specific incident path; general IT helpdesk only.
euAiActRefs: EU AI Act art. 12 (logs enabling incident detection) [verify]
questions.remediation: Extend the security IR plan with an AI intake path.

questions.text: Are AI incidents triaged with severity levels and a named responder?
questions.evidence: No severity levels defined for AI issues.
euAiActRefs: EU AI Act art. 9 (risk management; severity handling) [verify]
questions.remediation: Define severity rubric and on-call owner.

questions.text: Are post-incident reviews fed back into policy or system changes?
questions.evidence: After the misrouting outage (2026-05) fixes were made but nothing written down.
euAiActRefs: EU AI Act art. 9 (risk management; corrective actions) [verify]
questions.remediation: Add a lessons-learned step with tracked actions.

questions.text: Do employees receive training on approved vs. prohibited AI use for their role?
questions.evidence: One all-hands slide deck on ChatGPT policy from 2025; no role-based content.
euAiActRefs: EU AI Act art. 14 (human oversight; competence) [verify]
questions.remediation: Ship a role-based AI use training module.

questions.text: Is there an escalation path employees actually know for AI questions and concerns?
questions.evidence: Legal inbox published in handbook; usage unclear.
euAiActRefs: EU AI Act art. 14 (human oversight; escalation to humans) [verify]
questions.remediation: Publish one named contact and channel; test awareness.
